name: @yuhe520521/auto-mode
description: AGH Harness auto-mode policy advisor — provides tool execution policy and approval guidance for sandboxed auto-execution mode.

metadata.summary: Advises on tool execution policy and approval requirements for sandboxed auto-execution mode.
metadata.description: Provides a policy query tool that returns permission presets, risk classification, and approval guidance for tool execution in auto mode. Originally a host-level hook plugin that intercepted tool execution at runtime; degraded to an explicit query tool in AGH Harness.

zh-CN.summary: 为沙箱自动执行模式提供工具执行策略与审批建议。
zh-CN.description: 提供策略查询工具，返回权限预设、风险分级和审批指引。原为宿主钩子型插件，在运行时拦截工具执行；AGH Harness 中降级为显式查询工具。
